title: Responsibility and Regulation: Exploring Social Measures of Trust in Medical AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a qualitative study based on expert interviews about medical AI regulation and does not conduct a benchmark measurement of any kind, including those related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or discuss any aspects of religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on the regulation, development, and social measures of trust in medical artificial intelligence.
